scope: Read-only source comparison; no Godot edits or execution in this review. Other agents perform runtime validation.

findings.source: INFGroupManager.cpp:92-102; Godot uses AtlasTexture source_rect with bounds check
INFGroupImage.cpp:272-283; Godot adds TextureRect children in exported array order
CONTROL_TYPE=3 carries control_min/max; renderer merges controls into layout_bounds and does not draw them. JSON image_bounds_unrotated_local excludes controls by design.
Group metadata translation100,100 is not auto-applied; runtime callers supply origin. All selected group image bounds start0,0.
INFGroupImage::Render adds groupMinPos to child translation; renderer does not. Selected groups have min0,0 so no current discrepancy.

CINFGroupImage::CalculateMinMax multiplies scale_percent; CINFImageEx::Render draws m_v2Scaling without multiplying m_fScalePercent. Renderer multiplies it for draw too. All selected IMAGE records have scale_percent1, so current output unaffected.
Selected IMAGE angles are0 and scales nonnegative; pivot/reflection mapping for future variants is not proved by this dataset.
